text:
Lena: Pushed the latest blog draft to Drive -> please review for launch Friday. Focus: throughput + cost savings + webinar CTA. PTAL :link:
Omar: Read. Love the framing but the lead is too technical. Suggest replace 'amortized per-token cost' with 'lower cost per request' for clarity.
Clara: Added appendix with test harness and seed prompts. See section 'Bench methodology' for reproducibility.
Devon: Small nit: call out KV cache state in the bench caption. Otherwise numbers assume warmed cache and that's not obvious.
Sam: For CTA routing: Blog CTA -> modal signup -> HubSpot form -> segmented workflow: if eng role selected -> mark as MQL and ping sales queue. Will wire UTM params: `?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=launch&utm_campaign=q2_throughput`.
Lena: Good — I've added that CTA copy: 'View benchmarks & register for the webinar'.
LegalBot: Please include baseline definition for comparative claims and add a short consumer-facing disclaimer under the chart. 'Up to' claims okay with methodology link.
DesignBot: Uploaded assets: `hero_launch_v3.png`, `bench_chart_final.svg`. Alt text: 'Throughput (tokens/sec) and latency across models'. Recommend caption: 'Synthetic load; warmed KV cache (1k prefix); A100 pool.'
Omar: Also can we squeeze a 1-sentence CTO quote near the top? Draft: 'This release makes interactive LLM features practical at production scale.'
Clara: Quote sounds good. I've added it and linked the eval notebook.
Devon: Ops checklist: schedule publish Friday 8:30am PT for SEO + syndication. Add feature flag in CMS for webinar modal so we can toggle.
Lena: Final pass link: https://drive.google.com/.../q2-throughput-launch-draft — locking copy at 3pm PT today. Any objections?
Sam: Approved.
Omar: Approved apart from two tiny copy tweaks I pushed (simpler lead, change 'throughput' to 'requests/sec' in intro).
LegalBot: Quick pass after baseline & disclaimer added. No further holds.
Lena: Thanks team — scheduling publish and wiring HubSpot workflow now.
